entity.name: Joby vs Archer UAE exclusivity — explained
entity.meta_description: Joby holds a 6-year exclusive air-taxi agreement with RTA Dubai (Feb 2024). Archer operates from Abu Dhabi via ADIO, with Abu Dhabi Aviation as launch operator. How both coexist.
